races.paceDynamic: Inishbeg will take up the early running with limited pace pressure from a field where most prefer to come from behind. The lack of natural front-runners means Inishbeg can dictate fractions without serious challenge, while prominent runners like Advance Twentyfive, Simba's Pride, and Zarvali will track just behind. With so many hold-up horses needing room and luck in running, this race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Inishbeg Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Inishbeg gets an uncontested lead and maintains sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: Kevin Stott can dictate the race at his own pace, making it very difficult for the hold-up brigade to peg him back. The prominent runners like Advance Twentyfive and Zarvali will be best placed to capitalize if the leader falters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes slightly stronger with multiple horses tracking Inishbeg closely
scenarios.body: This creates the ideal scenario for horses like Advance Twentyfive and Zarvali who can travel strongly in behind before striking. The hold-up horses will still struggle to make up ground from the back of a large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If inexperience leads to a messy pace with horses getting in each other's way
scenarios.body: The large field of mostly lightly-raced horses creates traffic problems that could benefit any horse finding a clear run. Blue Boy Junior or Dream Odyssey might benefit from debut unknowns producing something special.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Inishbeg goes too fast early and the race falls apart in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Horses like Deep Sleep and Haltonwood, who stay well and have shown some ability, could pick up the pieces late. This requires everything to go wrong up front, which is unlikely given the lack of pace pressure.

races.paceDynamic: Iris Dancer is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the tempo without early pressure from the large field of hold-up and prominent runners. The pace will be honest but not frantic, with Lord Abama, Mr Dreamseller, Yes I'm Mali, and Ay Gee Ell settling in behind the leader through the first half. With 13 hold-up horses including Kings Merchant, Knicks, and Stirrup Cup waiting to pounce, this becomes a tactical affair where the early pace will be moderate before a fierce late charge. This race shape heavily favours the prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows prominent runners to stay within striking distance of Iris Dancer
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up horses creates a wall of traffic in the final two furlongs, allowing the well-positioned prominent runners to surge clear. Mr Dreamseller and Yes I'm Mali benefit most from their tactical positioning and superior ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the 13 hold-up horses bunch together turning for home creating severe interference
scenarios.body: The moderate pace ensures everyone stays in touch but the sheer volume of hold-up runners causes chaos in the straight. Only the horses with clear runs can capitalize, favoring those with tactical speed who can find gaps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer's uncontested lead proves too valuable in a large field where others struggle for racing room
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old gets first run on the field and holds on as the chasing pack encounters traffic problems behind. Her recent second at Southwell suggests she retains enough ability to exploit a good position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class Horse Overcomes Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If one of the higher-rated hold-up horses finds a clean passage through the crowded field
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, superior ability tells as Kings Merchant or Stirrup Cup weaves through to land the prize. Their handlers' expertise in big field handicaps proves crucial.

races.paceDynamic: Beaujolais Nouveau and City Captain are the only prominent runners, with Draupnir also showing pace tendencies but from a much lower mark. This lack of natural pace will create a moderate tempo early, with Beaujolais Nouveau likely to dictate from the front without serious pressure. The large field of hold-up horses including Murashah, Leadman, and Melvin Udall will be bunched behind, setting up a sprint finish from the 2f pole. This pace scenario strongly favours front-running and prominent horses who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will unfold when 10+ hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Beaujolais Nouveau gets an easy lead and City Captain settles behind rather than pressing
scenarios.body: The pace will be pedestrian through halfway, allowing the leaders to save energy for a sustained kick when the field closes. Hold-up horses will face a wall of traffic as they try to weave through the packed field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field remains tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure 2f sprint where the best recent form and strongest finishers prevail regardless of position. Those with tactical pace will find the gaps that matter.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent gets badly bunched and multiple horses are denied clear runs
scenarios.body: Those who can get first run or avoid the worst of the scrimmaging will capitalize while better horses are stuck behind walls of horses. Clean passages become crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improved Pace Test
scenarios.trigger: If City Captain or Draupnir decide to press Beaujolais Nouveau and create a genuine gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and favor those with proven stamina over this trip at a strong pace. Pure sprinters will struggle.

races.paceDynamic: Son appears the most likely pacesetter with his prominent style, but faces limited early pressure from fellow prominent runners Kosometsuke and It'sneverjustone. The majority of this field are hold-up horses (9 of 13) who will settle behind the early pace, creating a classic scenario where the leaders get an easy time of it early before facing late challenges. With so many closers needing room and relying on the pace collapsing, this race shape strongly favours the early speed and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Son and the prominent horses get an uncontested lead and maintain their kick
scenarios.body: The pace-setters get too easy a time early and have enough left to repel the late cavalry charge. The hold-up horses get in each other's way and can't make up the ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses swamp leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected or the prominent horses stop quickly
scenarios.body: The front-runners hit the wall in the final furlong allowing the fresher closers to come through with well-timed runs. Experience and class tell in the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield tactical success
scenarios.trigger: If a horse can position perfectly in behind the pace without getting too far back
scenarios.body: A runner gets the perfect trip tracking the leaders without doing too much work, then strikes at the ideal moment when others are either stopping or still making ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Son goes too fast early trying to make all or gets pressured into a speed duel
scenarios.body: The early gallop becomes unsustainable and everything comes back to the pack, allowing the biggest closers from the rear to sweep up.

races.paceDynamic: Don Simon will lead from the start with no serious pace pressure, setting a controlled gallop over this 1m4f trip. Idyllic might track closely as the only other prominent runner, but the majority of this field are hold-up horses who will settle well back. This creates a sustainable tempo early with acceleration reserves for the leaders, before the field compresses in the final three furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can dictate terms and kick clear when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Dictate Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Don Simon and Idyllic get an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: They can control the race completely and have first run on the field when quickening three furlongs out. The hold-up brigade faces a wall of horses and limited room to make their challenge effective.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the field stays tightly bunched
scenarios.body: The class horses with finishing kicks get their ideal scenario to unleash devastating late runs. Nightsinwhitesatin and Lightning Tiger can sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midrace Positioning Battle
scenarios.trigger: If several horses move forward approaching the turn to contest the pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with early positioning battles that compromise both leaders and hold-up horses. Those who secure good midfield spots without getting involved in scrimmaging benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Don Simon goes too slowly and gets swamped by multiple challengers early
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where pure speed matters most over tactical positioning. Fresh finishers with recent runs and good pace figures can capitalise.

races.paceDynamic: Merlier, Simplify, and Hanney Girl will ensure a strong early gallop with three confirmed front runners all wanting the lead. The prominent brigade - Daneh Of Dandy, The Lost Sock, Mo Of Cairo, Dazzling Haze, Exclamation, Rikki Tiki Tavi, and Schrodinger's Cat - creates severe congestion behind the leaders, guaranteeing traffic problems in the final two furlongs. Over this sharp 5f track, the sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Big Fun and Go Vince Go who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver late strikes when others are emptying.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is as strong as expected and the prominent runners get caught in traffic
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong as the front-runners tire and the midfield bunch kicks lumps out of each other. Big Fun and Go Vince Go sweep past tired legs with their superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner breaks clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses secures the perfect stalking position without getting trapped
scenarios.body: They avoid the worst of the scrimmaging while staying close enough to strike when the leaders weaken. The Lost Sock or Exclamation capitalize on their class advantage over a weakening field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If Merlier or Simplify can steal a march and open up daylight before the others react
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the chasers get bogged down in traffic behind them. Recent form suggests both are sharp enough to sustain the effort over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too fast early and completely burn each other out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between whoever escapes the traffic, with stamina less of a factor. Any of the prominent runners with a clear passage could capitalize on the tactical shambles.

scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace duel between Langholm and Stormy Pearl creates an honest gallop without being suicidal
scenarios.body: Golden Prosperity and Tommytwohoots can track the leaders and time their challenges perfectly. The genuine pace exposes the front-runners' stamina while the hold-up horses struggle for clear runs in the big field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong and the field strings out significantly
scenarios.body: The closing horses like Piperstown and Doon The Glen get the gaps they need as the pace collapses. Both horses have shown excellent recent form and can unleash telling late kicks when the race unfolds to suit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested or soft lead early
scenarios.body: Either Langholm or Stormy Pearl could steal a march if their rival doesn't engage seriously early on. The survivor would have enough left to resist the late challenges over this sharp track that often rewards those who get first run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a cavalry charge with the favourites inconveniencing each other
scenarios.body: The pace scenario and traffic problems could open the door for an outsider like Mister McGregor or Eldeyaar. These horses have shown glimpses of ability and could benefit from a messy race where the market leaders struggle.

watchPoints.text: Piperstown and Doon The Glen both need clear passages from hold-up positions in this big field where traffic problems are inevitable
Langholm and Stormy Pearl could set unsustainable fractions if both commit to the early lead battle
Golden Prosperity's recent course form makes him a key pace tracker to follow behind the leaders
Multiple horses returning from lengthy breaks including Emerald Army, Hurstwood, and Langholm face fitness tests
The going has remained consistently good throughout the card, favouring horses with proven form on this surface
